sources.prompt: Edit this approved pixel art MMORPG adventurer sprite sheet. Preserve the EXACT character, outfit, head size, hairstyle, navy tunic, brick-red scarf, brown boots/gloves and silver greatsword, pixel density and palette. Output a corrected sheet with exactly FOUR columns and THREE rows in the same layout. Middle row right-facing walk stays unchanged. Fix top row walking directly toward camera and bottom row walking directly away. Four sequential gait phases: column 1 left leg extended forward with right foot back; column 2 feet passing under hips, right knee flexed lifted; column 3 right leg extended forward with left foot back (genuinely opposite to column1); column4 feet passing under hips, left knee flexed lifted. Distinct contact/pass/opposite contact/pass. Upper body, hair and sword grip should remain almost identical across each row, no facial/head/proportion changes, no growth/shrinkage. Feet together in passing poses, foot dominance visibly swaps on opposite contact. Solid pure magenta background, no labels, no lines, no shadow. Keep feet on same row baseline and identical torso center at each equally spaced column. Leave ample empty padding around every sword tip. This is an animation correction not a redesign.
sources.correction_prompt: Correct ONLY the legs and boots in the top/front-facing row of this sprite sheet. Keep all heads, bodies, gloves, swords, scarf pixels, middle and bottom rows unchanged. Top column 1 already has the BOOT ON IMAGE LEFT extended LOWER than the right boot. For top column 3 REVERSE THAT: the BOOT ON IMAGE RIGHT must extend down to the ground baseline, while BOOT ON IMAGE LEFT is raised and tucked back with a bent knee. The rightmost boot in this third sprite must visibly be 3 native pixels LOWER than the leftmost boot. Column 2 and 4: feet pass nearly together below hips, with one lifted heel (opposite foot for each). This sheet must show actual alternating left-foot contact, passing, right-foot contact, passing. Top columns1 and3 cannot be the same pose. Retain EXACT existing character design, size, orientation, weapon, upper body and solid magenta background. No extra artwork.
sources.notes: Only down/up rows installed. Original left/right retained. Intermediate first edit rejected because front opposite-contact pose still led with same foot.

sources.prompt: Use case identity-preserve. Generate a new animation sprite sheet of the EXACT approved pixel adventurer shown: messy black hair, small normal MMORPG human, brick-red scarf, navy tunic, brown boots/gloves, silver broad straight greatsword dark fuller. Match reference proportions and pixel art completely. Asset: 8 columns by 3 rows evenly spaced on solid pure magenta, NO grid/text/effects/shadows. Rows face DOWN toward viewer, RIGHT profile, UP completely away (back of head only). Each row is one grounded two-handed HORIZONTAL WAIST-HEIGHT finishing sword sweep. Columns: 1 neutral ready guard; 2 coil torso and take blade to side at waist; 3 full side windup; 4 sword crosses horizontally at waist height; 5 extended opposite-side horizontal followthrough, both hands gripping hilt; 6 easing sword down into guard; 7 settle; 8 exact initial guard. NO overhead sword poses, NO downward stabbing, NO kneeling, NO ground slam. Strong torso twist and planted feet give weight, head/torso height and size stable, same head outfit palette throughout, same sword length and coherent hand-to-hilt attachment. Sword should never touch ground. All pixels of every blade tip fully inside its generous cell. Keep feet baseline constant in each row. Do not upscale the character relative to reference or alter design. Clean production sprite art with white slash effect deliberately omitted because engine renders it separately.
sources.notes: Only frames0-5 installed. Frame6 missing blade and frame7 blade touching source edge rejected; recovery settles into existing approved idle. Basic finisher only; Skill2 retains dedicated ground cleave.
